cmsis.description: The ARM Cortex Microcontroller Software Interface Standard (CMSIS) is a vendor-independent hardware abstraction layer for the Cortex-M processor series. CMSIS provides consistent and simple software interfaces for Cortex-M processors, peripherals, operating systems, and middleware.
